channel.title: Avora Digital Blog
channel.description: Practical guides on Shopify, custom websites, speed and conversion.

item.title: How to reduce COD returns on your online store in Pakistan
item.description: Cash on delivery brings orders, but refused parcels cost you delivery both ways. Here is why COD orders get refused and the store, confirmation and courier changes that reduce returns.

item.title: Why is my Shopify store slow? How to test it and what to fix first
item.description: How to check your Shopify store's speed with free tools, what LCP, INP and CLS mean, the six things that slow most stores down, and the order to fix them in.

item.title: Selling abroad from Pakistan: 6 store mistakes that stop Gulf and UK buyers
item.description: Overseas visitors often leave a Pakistani online store at the same six points. Here is what they are and how to fix each one, usually without building a new website.

item.title: Shopify or a custom website: which one does your brand need?
item.description: A plain comparison of Shopify and a custom-built website for brands in Pakistan, the Gulf and the UK: cost, speed to launch, payments, control and when each one is the wrong choice.
